<ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2024-01-01to2024-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000666" name="us-gaap:EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPPolicy"><p id="xdx_84B_eus-gaap--EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPPolicy_zk2qV9rEAAp" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: left"><b>Liability for employee rights upon retirement</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.75in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">Under Israeli law and labor agreements,
RNA is required to make severance payments to retired or dismissed employees and to employees leaving employment in certain other circumstances.
In respect of the liability to the employees, individual insurance policies are purchased, and deposits are made with recognized severance
pay funds. The liability for severance pay is calculated on the basis of the latest salary paid to each employee multiplied by the number
of years of employment. Employees are entitled to one month&#8217;s salary for each year of employment, or a portion thereof. The liability
is covered by the amounts deposited including accumulated income thereon as well as by the unfunded provision. Such liability is removed,
either upon termination of employment or retirement.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">According to Section 14 to the Severance
Pay Law (&#8220;Section 14&#8221;) the payment of monthly deposits by a company into recognized severance pay funds or insurance policies
releases it from any additional severance obligation to the employees that have entered into agreements with the company pursuant to such
Section 14. RNA has entered into agreements with some of its employees in order to implement Section 14. Therefore, the payment of monthly
deposits by RNA into recognized severance pay funds or insurance policies releases it from any additional severance obligation to those
employees that have entered into such agreements and therefore RNA incurs no additional liability since that date with respect to such
employees. Amounts accumulated in the severance pay funds or insurance policies pursuant to Section 14 are not supervised or administrated
by RNA and therefore neither such amounts nor the corresponding accrual are reflected in the balance sheets. &#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">Severance expenses for the years ended
December 31, 2024, and 2023 amounted to $<span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--SeveranceCosts1_c20240101__20241231_zkPJomRedP88" title="Severance expenses"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:SeveranceCosts1" contextRef="From2024-01-01to2024-12-31" id="Fact000668" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">27,747</ix:nonFraction></span> and $<span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--SeveranceCosts1_c20230101__20231231_z87FtAhNoHLk" title="Severance expenses"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:SeveranceCosts1" contextRef="From2023-01-012023-12-31" id="Fact000670" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">32,059</ix:nonFraction></span>, respectively.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2024-01-01to2024-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000672" name="us-gaap:StockholdersEquityNoteRedeemablePreferredStockIssuePolicy"><p id="xdx_844_eus-gaap--StockholdersEquityNoteRedeemablePreferredStockIssuePolicy_zZRbA6QtxqWb" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><b>Redeemable shares</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">The Company records its redeemable shares
at fair value less issuance costs on the dates of issuance. The Company has classified its redeemable shares as temporary equity (mezzanine)
on the consolidated balance sheet between liabilities and equity, due to redemption rights that are deemed outside of the Company&#8217;s
control and are presented at their carrying amount at the end of each period or until the end of the Lock Up period as defined in the agreement (see note 9 below).</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2024-01-01to2024-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000674" name="us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerPolicyTextBlock"><p id="xdx_84A_eus-gaap--RevenueFromContractWithCustomerPolicyTextBlock_zahFeMJteTP8" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: left"><b>Revenue recognition </b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">The Company&#8217;s revenues are
generated principally from providing cybersecurity technology services and from telecom services through Cross Mobile.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

from Contracts with Customers&#8221; and recognizes revenue when it satisfies performance obligations under the terms of its contracts
with customers in an amount that reflects the consideration the Company expects to be entitled to in exchange for those services.&#160;</p>

<ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2024-01-01to2024-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000680" name="us-gaap:EarningsPerSharePolicyTextBlock"><p id="xdx_846_eus-gaap--EarningsPerSharePolicyTextBlock_zRc5qxqZGMQ8" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: left"><b>Basic and diluted loss per common share
</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">Basic net loss per share is computed based
on the weighted average number of shares outstanding during each&#160;year. Diluted net loss per share is computed based on the weighted
average number of common shares outstanding during each&#160;year, plus the dilutive potential of the common stock considered outstanding
during the&#160;year, in accordance with ASC 260-10 &#8220;Earnings per Share&#8221;.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: left"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">Accounts&#160;receivable are stated

losses, which is established based on reviews of the&#160;accounts&#160;receivable aging, an assessment of the customer&#8217;s history

of the outstanding balance is no longer probable. is reflected in net accounts receivable. The Group does not have any off-balance-sheet credit exposure related to its customers.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: left"><b>&#160;</b></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2024-01-01to2024-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000696" name="us-gaap:LossContingencyDisclosures"><p id="xdx_84A_eus-gaap--LossContingencyDisclosures_zsJEZoOQjD0a" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: left"><b>Contingencies</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 56.7pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company follows ASC 450-20, Loss Contingencies, to report accounting for contingencies. Liabilities for loss contingencies arising from
claims, assessments, litigation, fines and penalties and other sources are recorded when it is probable that a liability has been incurred
and the amount of the assessment can be reasonably estimated. As of December 31, 2024, the Company didn&#8217;t record any loss contingencies.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2024-01-01to2024-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000698" name="us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementPolicyPolicyTextBlock"><p id="xdx_841_eus-gaap--FairValueMeasurementPolicyPolicyTextBlock_zdNcxnGCHr62" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Fair
Value Measurements</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 49.6pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company measures and discloses fair value in accordance with the Financial Accounting Standards Board (&#8220;FASB&#8221;), Accounting
Standards Codification 820, Fair Value Measurements and Disclosures (&#8220;ASC Topic 820&#8221;). ASC Topic 820 defines fair value, establishes
a framework and gives guidance regarding the methods used for measuring fair value, and expands disclosures about fair value measurements.
Fair value is an exit price, representing the amount that would be received to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly
transaction between market participants at the measurement date. As such, fair value is a market-based measurement that should be determined
based on assumptions that market participants would use in pricing an asset or liability. As a basis for considering such assumptions
there exists a three-tier fair-value hierarchy, which prioritizes the inputs used in measuring fair value as follows:</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 49.6pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Level
1 - unadjusted quoted prices are available in active markets for identical assets or liabilities that the Company has the ability to
access as of the measurement date</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 3.3pt 0 85.05pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Level
2 &#8211; pricing inputs are other than quoted prices in active markets that are directly observable for the asset or liability or indirectly
observable through corroboration with observable market data.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 3.4pt 0 56.7pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Level
3 &#8211; pricing inputs are unobservable for the non-financial asset or liability and only used when there is little, if any, market
activity for the non-financial asset or liability at the measurement date. The inputs into the determination of fair value require significant
management judgment or estimation. Level 3 inputs are considered as the lowest priority within the fair value hierarchy.</span></p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">This
hierarchy requires the Company to use observable market data, when available, and to minimize the use of unobservable inputs when determining
fair value.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 49.6pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
fair value of cash and cash equivalents is based on its demand value, which is equal to its carrying value. Additionally, the carrying
value of all other short term monetary assets and liabilities are estimated to be equal to their fair value due to the short-term nature
of these instruments.</span></p>

<p style="font: 11pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 49.6pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2024-01-01to2024-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000700" name="us-gaap:NewAccountingPronouncementsPolicyPolicyTextBlock"><p id="xdx_840_eus-gaap--NewAccountingPronouncementsPolicyPolicyTextBlock_zvGjpmK8vLa" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: left"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>New
Accounting Pronouncements</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 1in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: left"><b>Recently Adopted Accounting Standards</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.75in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">Segment Reporting: In November 2023, the
FASB issued ASU No. 2023-07, Segment Reporting (Topic 280): Improvements to Reportable Segment Disclosures. It requires incremental disclosures
related to an entity&#8217;s reportable segments, including (i) significant segment expense categories and amounts for each reportable
segment that are provided to the chief operating decision maker (&#8220;CODM&#8221;), (ii) an aggregate amount and description of other
segment items included in each reported measure, (iii) all annual disclosures about a reportable segment&#8217;s profit or loss and assets
required by Topic 280 to be disclosed in interim periods, (iv) the title and position of the individual or the name of the group identified
as the CODM and (v) an explanation of how the CODM uses the reported measures of segment profit or loss to assess performance and allocate
resources to the segment. The standard improves transparency by providing disaggregated expense information about an entity&#8217;s reportable
segments. The standard does not change the definition of a segment, the method for determining segments or the criteria for aggregating
operating segments into reportable segments. This guidance is effective for annual reporting periods beginning after December 15, 2023,
and interim reporting periods beginning after December 15, 2024. The Company adopted this guidance retrospectively, providing the additional
disclosures as required. See note 19, for more information.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: left"><b>Accounting Standards Not Yet Adopted</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">Income Taxes: In December 2023, the FASB
issued ASU 2023-09, Income Taxes (Topic 740): Improvements to Income Tax Disclosures. The amendments in this ASU add specific requirements
for income tax disclosures to improve transparency and decision usefulness. The guidance in ASU 2023-09 requires that public business
entities disclose specific categories in the income tax rate reconciliation and provide additional qualitative information for reconciling
items that meet a quantitative threshold. In addition, the amendments in ASU 2023-09 require that all entities disclose the amount of
income taxes paid disaggregated by federal, state, and foreign taxes and disaggregated by individual jurisdictions. The ASU also includes
other disclosure amendments related to the disaggregation of income tax expense between federal, state and foreign taxes. For public business
entities, the amendments in this update are effective for annual periods beginning after December 15, 2024. Early adoption is permitted
for annual financial statements that have not yet been issued or made available for issuance. The amendments in this update should be
applied on a prospective basis and retrospective application is permitted. The Company is currently evaluating this ASU to determine its
impact on the Company&#8217;s disclosures.</p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: center">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 56.7pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -56.7pt"><b>NOTE 2 - SUMMARY
OF SIGNIFICANT ACCOUNTING POLICIES AND BASIS OF PRESENTATION (cont.)</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.75in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">In November 2024, the FASB issued ASU No.
2024-03 Income Statement&#8212;Reporting Comprehensive Income&#8212;Expense Disaggregation Disclosures (Subtopic 220-40). The ASU improves
the disclosures about a public business entity&#8217;s expense and provides more detailed information about the types of expenses in commonly
presented expense captions. The amendments require that at each interim and annual reporting period an entity will, inter alia, disclose
amounts of purchases of inventory, employee compensation, depreciation and amortization included in each relevant expense caption (such
as cost of sales, SG&amp;A and research and development). Amounts remaining in relevant expense captions that are not separately disclosed
will be described qualitatively. Certain amounts that are already required to be disclosed under currently effective U.S GAAP will be
included in the same disclosure as the other disaggregation requirements. The amendments also require disclosing the total amount of selling
expenses and, in annual reporting periods, the definition of selling expenses. The ASU is effective for fiscal years beginning after December
15, 2026, and interim periods within fiscal years beginning after December 15, 2027. Early adoption is permitted. The Company is currently
evaluating this ASU to determine its impact on the Company&#8217;s disclosures.</p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: center">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">As detailed in note 1 C above, on October
25, 2022, the Company exercised the Additional Share Purchase Option and acquired the additional <span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--EquityMethodInvestmentOwnershipPercentage_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20221025__srt--ScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentEquityMethodInvesteeNameAxis__custom--CrossMobileMember_zoOKsS4jRIWb" title="Equity method investment percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentOwnershipPercentage" contextRef="AsOf2022-10-25_custom_CrossMobileMember" id="Fact000835" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">25</ix:nonFraction></span>% shares of CrossMobile such that following
the acquisition, the Company increased its holding from <span id="xdx_906_eus-gaap--EquityMethodInvestmentOwnershipPercentage_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20221025__srt--ScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentEquityMethodInvesteeNameAxis__custom--CrossMobileMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember_zqQBd5Yw8QT8" title="Equity method investment percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentOwnershipPercentage" contextRef="AsOf2022-10-25_custom_CrossMobileMember_srt_MinimumMember" id="Fact000837" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">26</ix:nonFraction></span>% to <span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--EquityMethodInvestmentOwnershipPercentage_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20221025__srt--ScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentEquityMethodInvesteeNameAxis__custom--CrossMobileMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember_zmlcZraScB96" title="Equity method investment percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentOwnershipPercentage" contextRef="AsOf2022-10-25_custom_CrossMobileMember_srt_MaximumMember" id="Fact000839" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">51</ix:nonFraction></span>% of CrossMobile&#8217;s outstanding common stock on a fully diluted
basis. In consideration for the exercise of the Additional Share Purchase Option, the Company issued <span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRestrictedStockAwardGross_pid_c20221128__20221128__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--CrossMobileMember__us-gaap--StatementEquityComponentsAxis__us-gaap--CommonStockMember_zEc8jt595s9b" title="Shares issued for exercise of option"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRestrictedStockAwardGross" contextRef="From2022-11-282022-11-28_custom_CrossMobileMember_us-gaap_CommonStockMember" id="Fact000841" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">10,000,000</ix:nonFraction></span> restricted common stock
on November 28, 2022 to Crossmobile.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">The Company concluded that the acquired
set of assets held at CrossMobile does not meet the definition of a business as substantially all the fair value of the gross assets is
concentrated in the license held by CrossMobile. CrossMobile is at it start up stages and has no substantial operations. The only significant
asset is the license which constitute more than <span id="xdx_901_ecustom--LicensePercentageInConsideration_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20221025__srt--ScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentEquityMethodInvesteeNameAxis__custom--CrossMobileMember_zVhU1TDPpnR7" title="License percentage in consideration paid"><ix:nonFraction name="WHEN:LicensePercentageInConsideration" contextRef="AsOf2022-10-25_custom_CrossMobileMember" id="Fact000843" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">90</ix:nonFraction></span>% of the consideration paid.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">The acquisition of the additional <span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--EquityMethodInvestmentOwnershipPercentage_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20221025__srt--ScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentEquityMethodInvesteeNameAxis__custom--CrossMobileMember_z6vGIZJhf0W" title="Equity method investment percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentOwnershipPercentage" contextRef="AsOf2022-10-25_custom_CrossMobileMember" id="Fact000845" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">25</ix:nonFraction></span>% constitute
an asset acquisition in stages and resulted in obtaining control over all assets of CrossMobile and consolidating CrossMobile as of October
25, 2022.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">The Company used the cost accumulation
method to determine the cost of the acquisition. The Company used the carrying value of its <span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--AcquisitionCostRatio_pid_dp_uPure_c20221025__20221025_zWSBAklulbga" title="Acquisition cost ratio"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:AcquisitionCostRatio" contextRef="From2022-10-252022-10-25" id="Fact000847" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">26</ix:nonFraction></span>% interest and did not recognize any gain
or loss on the interest held at CrossMobile previously.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">The consideration for the assets of CrossMobile
was made through the issuance of <span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesPurchaseOfAssets_pid_c20221025__20221025__us-gaap--StatementEquityComponentsAxis__us-gaap--CommonStockMember__srt--ScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentEquityMethodInvesteeNameAxis__custom--CrossMobileMember_zTxwcpVyDRFe" title="Shares issued for asset acquisition"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesPurchaseOfAssets" contextRef="From2022-10-252022-10-25_us-gaap_CommonStockMember_custom_CrossMobileMember" id="Fact000849" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">20,000,000,000</ix:nonFraction></span> WHEN common shares with total fair value of $<span id="xdx_90D_eus-gaap--StockIssuedDuringPeriodValuePurchaseOfAssets_pn6n6_c20221025__20221025__srt--ScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentEquityMethodInvesteeNameAxis__custom--CrossMobileMember_zsbzQToS5jZc" title="Fair value of shares issued for asset acquisition"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodValuePurchaseOfAssets" contextRef="From2022-10-252022-10-25_custom_CrossMobileMember" id="Fact000851" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6" scale="6" unitRef="USD">8</ix:nonFraction></span> million ($<span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--SharesIssuedPricePerShare_iI_c20221025__srt--ScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentEquityMethodInvesteeNameAxis__custom--CrossMobileMember_zVKtSGKgV4qg" title="Shares issued, price per share"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:SharesIssuedPricePerShare" contextRef="AsOf2022-10-25_custom_CrossMobileMember" id="Fact000853" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">0.0004</ix:nonFraction></span> per share) and was issued
to CrossMobile and not the shareholders of CrossMobile. Hence, upon obtaining control over all the assets of CrossMobile, the Company
has gained control over its own shares held at CrossMobile. Based on the guidance in ASC 810-10-45-5, shares held by a subsidiary would
not be considered outstanding and hence, the <span id="xdx_906_eus-gaap--TreasuryStockCommonShares_iI_pid_c20241231_zJpKiMwKu3c8" title="Treasury stock, shares"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:TreasuryStockCommonShares" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31" id="Fact000855" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">20,000,000,000</ix:nonFraction></span> common shares of the Company held by CrossMobile are presented as treasury
shares in the consolidated balance sheet.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">The assets acquisition of CrossMobile resulted
in <span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationMinorityInterestIncomeExpense_pid_dp_uPure_c20221025__20221025__srt--OwnershipAxis__custom--CrossMobileMember_zTdTclzOGdJh" title="Percentage of noncontrolling interests"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationMinorityInterestIncomeExpense" contextRef="From2022-10-252022-10-25_custom_CrossMobileMember14626640" id="Fact000857" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">49</ix:nonFraction></span>% noncontrolling interests in CrossMobile. The Company analogized from ASC 805-30-30-1 and added the fair value of the noncontrolling
interests to the consideration paid for the assets acquired.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><b>NOTE 7 - ASSET ACQUISITION OF

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">As described above the entire consideration
paid by WHEN was with its shares, issued to CrossMobile. Based on the guidance in ASC 810-10-45-5 the shares are not considered outstanding.
The Company concluded that the fair value of the consideration paid to be based on the fair value of the noncontrolling interests determined
to be $<span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--BusinessCombinationAcquisitionOfLessThan100PercentNoncontrollingInterestFairValue_iI_pn5n6_c20221025__srt--OwnershipAxis__custom--CrossMobileMember_znIlnmXV4VIb" title="Fair value of the noncontrolling interests"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationAcquisitionOfLessThan100PercentNoncontrollingInterestFairValue" contextRef="AsOf2022-10-25_custom_CrossMobileMember14626687" id="Fact000859" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">7.9</ix:nonFraction></span> million.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">Substantially all the consideration were
allocated to the license, additionally to $<span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionCostOfAcquiredEntityTransactionCosts_iI_pn5n6_c20221025_zLHztXtDpxw6" title="Transaction costs"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:BusinessAcquisitionCostOfAcquiredEntityTransactionCosts" contextRef="AsOf2022-10-25" id="Fact000861" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">0.9</ix:nonFraction></span> million costs incurred in connection of the transaction, and hence the license was recognized
at $<span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--FiniteLivedLicenseAgreementsGross_iI_pn5n6_c20221025_zd8oammsKiY" title="Recognized value of license"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:FiniteLivedLicenseAgreementsGross" contextRef="AsOf2022-10-25" id="Fact000863" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">8.8</ix:nonFraction></span> million.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">Additionally, the Company recorded deferred
tax liability and corresponding increase of the license value in an amount of $<span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--DeferredTaxLiabilities_iI_pn3n6_c20221025_zSesArivwmMi" title="Deferred tax liabilities, net"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DeferredTaxLiabilities" contextRef="AsOf2022-10-25" id="Fact000865" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="6" unitRef="USD">0.872</ix:nonFraction></span> million, based on ASC 740-10-55-170 that accounts

assuming tax basis of $<span id="xdx_908_ecustom--TaxBasisAmount_iI_pn3n3_c20221025_zTl0W8H5iBtc" title="Tax basis amount"><ix:nonFraction name="WHEN:TaxBasisAmount" contextRef="AsOf2022-10-25" id="Fact000867" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">0</ix:nonFraction></span>.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">Company&#8217;s investment in CrossMobile
is tested annually for impairment, using an independent third party evaluator. As of December 31, 2024 and 2023, no impairment was identified.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">On July 2, 2024, the Company, entered into
and executed an agreement (the &#8220;IHQ Agreement&#8221;) with Intent HQ Limited (&#8220;IHQ&#8221;), a company incorporated under the
laws of England and Wales pursuant to which IHQ invested and granted the Company a worldwide, royalty-free, perpetual, nonexclusive, sublicensable,
irrevocable license to IHQ&#8217;s Edge SDK, in both source-code and object-code formats and associated documentation (collectively, the
&#8220;Perpetual License&#8221;). In consideration of the Perpetual License the Company issued <span id="xdx_909_ecustom--StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRedeemableShares_pid_c20240702__20240702__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--IHQAgreementMember__us-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis__custom--PerpetualLicenseMember_zlDau1VOYrhh" title="Consideration shares for license"><ix:nonFraction name="WHEN:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRedeemableShares" contextRef="From2024-07-022024-07-02_custom_IHQAgreementMember_custom_PerpetualLicenseMember" id="Fact000899" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">25,038,272,832</ix:nonFraction></span> shares (the &#8220;Consideration
Shares&#8221;) of Company&#8217;s common stock (the &#8220;Common Stock&#8221;). The Consideration Shares represents approximately <span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardPercentageOfOutstandingStockMaximum_pid_dp_c20240702__20240702__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--IHQAgreementMember__us-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis__custom--PerpetualLicenseMember_zwtLEZcPEzx6" title="Percentage of issued and outstanding share capital"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardPercentageOfOutstandingStockMaximum" contextRef="From2024-07-022024-07-02_custom_IHQAgreementMember_custom_PerpetualLicenseMember" id="Fact000901" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">4.8</ix:nonFraction></span>%
of the issued and outstanding share capital of the Company following such issuance. Under the terms of the IHQ Agreement, IHQ also undertook
to provide professional consulting services to enable the Company to implement, develop and commercialize its own and joined products
based on the product materials or any portions or derivative works thereof, all subject to the terms and conditions set forth therein.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">The strategic alliance represented by this
agreement aims to leverage WHEN&#8217;s cybersecurity products in combination with IHQ&#8217;s modules to introduce to the market novel
products in the cybersecurity field applicable to both the business and individual level.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">The IHQ Agreement provides that the Consideration
Shares are subject to a Lock Up Agreement for a period of 12 months from the date of their issuance, but the lock up would be automatically
canceled on the date of the Uplisting (as defined below). In addition, the lock up may be cancelled unilaterally by IHQ, in its sole discretion,
in which case the Perpetual License will be considered fully paid. Under the terms of the IHQ Agreement, the Company undertook to complete
an uplisting (the &#8220;Uplisting&#8221;) of its shares of Common Stock on NYSE, NASDAQ or the Chicago Board Options Exchange prior to
June 28, 2025 (the &#8220;Uplisting Target Date&#8221;).</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">Under the terms of the IHQ Agreement, the
Company may at any time prior to the Uplisting Target Date, at its sole discretion without any obligation whatsoever, pay IHQ in cash
$<span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--ProceedsFromLicenseFeesReceived_pn6n6_c20240702__20240702__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--IHQAgreementMember__us-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis__custom--PerpetualLicenseMember_zRFkJesAjJU2" title="License fee"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromLicenseFeesReceived" contextRef="From2024-07-022024-07-02_custom_IHQAgreementMember_custom_PerpetualLicenseMember" id="Fact000903" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6" scale="6" unitRef="USD">5</ix:nonFraction></span> million dollar as a license fee for the Perpetual License, upon which the entirety of the Consideration Shares shall be returned to
the Company. If the Uplisting occurs on or before the Uplisting Target Date, then upon Uplisting the Perpetual License shall be deemed
to have been fully paid for by the issuance of the Consideration Shares, and all of IHQ&#8217;s rights of termination of the Agreement
and rights related to cancellation of Lock Up shall terminate and no longer be in force and effect. However, <span id="xdx_909_ecustom--UplistingTargetDateDescription_pn6n6_c20240702__20240702__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--IHQAgreementMember__us-gaap--FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis__custom--PerpetualLicenseMember_z6zKBiPzYO5e" title="Uplisting target date description"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2024-07-022024-07-02_custom_IHQAgreementMember_custom_PerpetualLicenseMember" id="Fact000905" name="WHEN:UplistingTargetDateDescription">if the Uplisting does not
occur before the Uplisting Target Date and, or the Company has not paid $5 million license fee for the Perpetual License, then IHQ has

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">In the event that the Company or a subsidiary
will raise funds on or prior to December 28, 2025 (the &#8220;Target Fundraise Period&#8221;) in connection with, from or relating to
the Uplisting (whether or not the Uplisting ultimately occurs) for a specified amount (the &#8220;Target Fundraise&#8221;), the Company
is obligated to pay IHQ a marketing advisory fee at a specified the rate for each dollar cumulatively raised during the Target Fundraise
Period over and above the Target Fundraise.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">The Company estimated the value of the

  <td style="text-align: justify; width: 0.25in">1.</td>
  <td style="text-align: justify">On October 27, 2020 the Company filed suit in State Court, Palm Beach County, Florida, against FSC Solutions, Inc. (&#8220;FSC&#8221;),
Eli Gal Levy (&#8220;EL&#8221;) and Padem Consultants Sprl (collectively, the &#8220;Defendants&#8221;). The suit relates to the Stock
Purchase Agreement entered into by the Company with FSC and its shareholders, which included EL, pursuant to which the Company acquired
all of the issued and outstanding stock of FSC in exchange for the issuance of <span id="xdx_904_eus-gaap--StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues_pn9n9_c20201027__20201027__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--FSCSolutionsIncMember_zwAh2PTbG1x4" title="Stock issuance of shares"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues" contextRef="From2020-10-272020-10-27_custom_FSCSolutionsIncMember" id="Fact000956" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-9" scale="9" unitRef="Shares">70</ix:nonFraction></span>
billion shares of the Company unregistered common stock. FSC was the putative owner of a software and trading platform which the Company
intended to use to enter into the on-line trading business. Subsequent to the completion of the acquisition, the Company determined that
FSC did not have control over the trading platform and software the Company expected to acquire and operate. The suit seeks declaratory
judgment to unwind the FSC transaction and cancel the shares of the Company common stock issued in the FSC transaction that are still
outstanding.</td></tr>

Gal Levy (&#8220;EL&#8221;) filed a lawsuit in the Delaware Court of Chancery seeking to remove the restrictive legend from all the shares
of Common Stock held by EL (the &#8220;2022 Lawsuit&#8221;), which are approximately <span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--TreasuryStockCommonShares_iI_c20220119_ziMrcwpuEf0i" title="Common Stock held in treasury"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:TreasuryStockCommonShares" contextRef="AsOf2022-01-19" id="Fact000958" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">23,000,000,000</ix:nonFraction></span> shares. defending the EL&#8217;s Lawsuit. Trial is scheduled for May 5 and 6, 2025.</p>

may become involved in various lawsuits and legal proceedings which arise in the ordinary course of business. However, litigation is
subject to inherent uncertainties, and an adverse result in these or other matters may arise from time to time that may harm our
business. We are not aware of any such legal proceedings or claims against us.</p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2024-01-01to2024-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact000962" name="us-gaap:StockholdersEquityNoteDisclosureTextBlock"><p id="xdx_80E_eus-gaap--StockholdersEquityNoteDisclosureTextBlock_zzRTkSRA3tP5" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 56.7pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -56.7pt"><b>NOTE 12 &#8211;
<span id="xdx_820_zVcZw9jQ8rT5">SHAREHOLDERS&#8217; EQUITY</span></b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 56.7pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -56.7pt">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><b><i>Description of the rights attached
to the shares in the Company:</i></b>&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><b>Common stock</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">Each share of common stock entitles the
holder to one vote, either in person or by proxy, at meetings of stockholders. The holders are not permitted to vote their shares cumulatively.
Accordingly, the stockholders of the Company&#8217;s common stock who hold, in the aggregate, more than fifty percent of the total voting
rights can elect all of the directors and, in such event, the holders of the remaining minority shares will not be able to elect any of
such directors. The vote of the holders of a majority of the issued and outstanding shares of common stock entitled to vote thereon is
sufficient to authorize, affirm, ratify or consent to such act or action, except as otherwise provided by law.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify"><b>Series A preferred stock</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">The holders of Series A preferred stock
have the right to vote with the common stock on all matters. <span id="xdx_906_eus-gaap--PreferredStockVotingRights_c20240101__20241231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__us-gaap--SeriesAPreferredStockMember_zU2lZkAA2194" title="Preferred stock voting rights, description"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2024-01-012024-12-31_us-gaap_SeriesAPreferredStockMember" id="Fact000964" name="us-gaap:PreferredStockVotingRights">Each share of Series A preferred stock has 10,000 votes per share</ix:nonNumeric></span>. Each of
George Baumoehl and Gaya Rozensweig, the directors of the Company, hold <span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--TreasuryStockPreferredShares_iI_c20241231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__us-gaap--SeriesAPreferredStockMember__srt--TitleOfIndividualAxis__custom--GeorgeBaumoehlAndGayaRozensweigMember_zpDlOm3yfwt2" title="Number of shares hold"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:TreasuryStockPreferredShares" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31_us-gaap_SeriesAPreferredStockMember_custom_GeorgeBaumoehlAndGayaRozensweigMember" id="Fact000966" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">2,500,000</ix:nonFraction></span> shares of the Series A preferred stock. The Series A
preferred stock have no dividend and liquidation preferences.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">The aggregate intrinsic value of the option
awards outstanding as of December 31, 2024 is $<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsAggregateIntrinsicValueOutstanding_iI_pp0p0_c20241231_zd2YgrCqlk8h" title="Aggregate intrinsic value outstanding"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsAggregateIntrinsicValueOutstanding" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31" id="Fact001133" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" scale="0" unitRef="USD">0</ix:nonFraction></span>. These amounts represent the total intrinsic value, based on the Company&#8217;s stock
price of $<span id="xdx_904_eus-gaap--SharePrice_iI_c20241231_z6d1MgepaMNl" title="Share price"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:SharePrice" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31" id="Fact001135" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">0.0001</ix:nonFraction></span> as of December 31, 2024, less the weighted exercise price. This represents the potential amount received by the option
holders had all option holders exercised their options as of that date.</p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2024-01-01to2024-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact001250" name="us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentsDisclosureTextBlock"><p id="xdx_804_eus-gaap--EquityMethodInvestmentsDisclosureTextBlock_zDQ3HiSlRvUg" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 63.8pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: -63.8pt"><b>NOTE 17 - <span id="xdx_827_zFuce4sFC8ab">EQUITY
METHOD INVESTMENTS IN UNCONSOLIDATED AFFILIATES</span></b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">The Company applies the equity method to
investments when it has an ability to exercise significant influence over the operational decision-making authority and financial policies
of the investee.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">During the year ended December 31, 2023,
the Company accounted for its <span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--EquityMethodInvestmentOwnershipPercentage_iI_dp_c20231231__srt--ScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentEquityMethodInvesteeNameAxis__custom--InstaViewLtdMember_z7tClgyE3ptg" title="Equity method investment percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentOwnershipPercentage" contextRef="AsOf2023-12-31_custom_InstaViewLtdMember" id="Fact001252" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">26</ix:nonFraction></span>% investments in InstaView as equity method investment from January 26, 2023.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

</ix:nonNumeric><p id="xdx_8AA_zFG3Luy343ib" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 63.8pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -63.8pt"><b>&#160;</b></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2024-01-01to2024-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact001274" name="us-gaap:IncomeTaxDisclosureTextBlock"><p id="xdx_800_eus-gaap--IncomeTaxDisclosureTextBlock_z9tVxL84JqEd" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 63.8pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -63.8pt"><b>NOTE 18 &#8211; <span id="xdx_827_zTTXEDdPHmQk">INCOME
TAX</span></b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: left; text-indent: -63.8pt"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">The Company is subject to the U.S. federal
income tax rate of <span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationAtFederalStatutoryIncomeTaxRate_pid_dp_uPure_c20240101__20241231_z2d0W0L4af25"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationAtFederalStatutoryIncomeTaxRate" contextRef="From2024-01-01to2024-12-31" id="Fact001275" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">21</ix:nonFraction></span>% plus state income tax rates which vary from state to state. Income of the Israeli company is taxable at enacted
tax rate of <span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationAtFederalStatutoryIncomeTaxRate_pid_dp_uPure_c20240101__20241231__us-gaap--IncomeTaxAuthorityNameAxis__us-gaap--IsraelTaxAuthorityMember_zpVawouClGXj"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationAtFederalStatutoryIncomeTaxRate" contextRef="From2024-01-012024-12-31_us-gaap_IsraelTaxAuthorityMember" id="Fact001276" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">23</ix:nonFraction></span>%.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">Income of the Poland company is taxable
at enacted tax rate between <span id="xdx_906_eus-gaap--EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationAtFederalStatutoryIncomeTaxRate_pid_dp_uPure_c20240101__20241231__us-gaap--IncomeTaxAuthorityNameAxis__custom--PolandTaxAuthorityMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember_zS3hx2w9RlId"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationAtFederalStatutoryIncomeTaxRate" contextRef="From2024-01-012024-12-31_custom_PolandTaxAuthorityMember_srt_MinimumMember" id="Fact001277" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">9</ix:nonFraction></span>% - <span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationAtFederalStatutoryIncomeTaxRate_pid_dp_uPure_c20240101__20241231__us-gaap--IncomeTaxAuthorityNameAxis__custom--PolandTaxAuthorityMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember_zDbgAOiLzak5" title="Federal statutory income tax rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationAtFederalStatutoryIncomeTaxRate" contextRef="From2024-01-012024-12-31_custom_PolandTaxAuthorityMember_srt_MaximumMember" id="Fact001279" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">19</ix:nonFraction></span>%.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">The Company and its Israeli and Polish
subsidiaries have not received final tax assessments since the subsidiaries&#8217; inception.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">The Company&#8217;s tax years beginning
2016 are open for assessment and, for the subsidiaries, all tax years from commencement are open for assessment.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">As of December 31, 2024, the Company and
its subsidiaries have carryforward losses for tax purposes of approximately $<span id="xdx_906_eus-gaap--OperatingLossCarryforwards_iI_c20241231_zcCC2k5pAYce" title="Operating loss carryforwards"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:OperatingLossCarryforwards" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31" id="Fact001281" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">32,865</ix:nonFraction></span> thousand and $<span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--OperatingLossCarryforwards_iI_c20231231_zMbjlhPZ0rIg" title="Operating loss carryforwards"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:OperatingLossCarryforwards" contextRef="AsOf2023-12-31" id="Fact001283" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">4,189</ix:nonFraction></span> thousand, respectively, which
can be offset against future taxable income, if any. As of December 31, 2024, approximately $<span id="xdx_904_eus-gaap--DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwardsSubjectToExpiration_iI_pn5n6_c20241231_zw41GsrzEpHc" title="Operating loss carryforwards expiration"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwardsSubjectToExpiration" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31" id="Fact001285" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">26.9</ix:nonFraction></span> million will <span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--OperatingLossCarryforwardsLimitationsOnUse_c20240101__20241231_zzN9HM8EnLnj" title="Operating loss carryforwards expiration period"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2024-01-01to2024-12-31" id="Fact001287" name="us-gaap:OperatingLossCarryforwardsLimitationsOnUse">expire between the years
2036 and 2040</ix:nonNumeric></span>, and the remainder has no expiration date.</p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2024-01-01to2024-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact001406" name="us-gaap:SegmentReportingDisclosureTextBlock"><p id="xdx_808_eus-gaap--SegmentReportingDisclosureTextBlock_zICLyWYHi2Sb" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><b>NOTE 20 &#8211; <span id="xdx_824_zHeAaqyE1nki">SEGMENT REPORTING</span></b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">
<td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 0.5in"><span style="font-size: 10pt"><b>A.</b></span></td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><span style="font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: -0.15pt"><b>Information about reported segment profit or
loss and assets</b></span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 39.3pt; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="background-color: white">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="background-color: white">This
segment&#8217;s structure reflects the financial information and reports used by the Company&#8217;s management, specifically its CODM, to make
decisions regarding the Company&#8217;s business, including resource allocations and performance assessments, as well as the current operating
focus in compliance with ASC&#160;280,&#160;Segment Reporting. The Company&#8217;s reportable segments are not aggregated.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 39.3pt; text-align: justify; background-color: white">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="background-color: white">The
Company reports segment information based on the management approach, which designates the internal reporting used by the Chief Operating
Decision Maker (&#8220;CODM&#8221;), the Company&#8217;s Chief Executive Officer, for making decisions and assessing performance as the
source of the Company&#8217;s reportable segments. The CODM allocate resources and assesses the performance of each operating segment
based on potential business opportunities, historical and potential future sales and operating expenses. </span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 39.3pt; text-align: justify; background-color: white">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="background-color: white">The
Company has <span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--NumberOfReportableSegments_pid_dc_uSegment_c20240101__20241231_zTgkb9ULSAT5" title="Number of reportable segments"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:NumberOfReportableSegments" contextRef="From2024-01-01to2024-12-31" id="Fact001408" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" decimals="INF" unitRef="Segment">two</ix:nonFraction></span> reportable segments: (i)</span> global telecom<span style="background-color: white">, and (ii) </span>cybersecurity technology<span style="background-color: white">.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 39.3pt; text-align: justify; background-color: white">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="background-color: white">The
Company&#8217;s method for measuring profitability on a reportable segment basis is operating loss. The Company adopted ASU 2023-07 in
December 2024. The most significant provision was for the Company to disclose significant segment expenses that are regularly provided
to the CODM. The Company&#8217;s CODM periodically reviews operating loss by segment and treats it as a significant segment expense.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">&#160;</p>
